lessons_learned: NestJS lifecycle: constructor validation runs BEFORE onModuleInit — never validate DI state in constructors, use OnApplicationBootstrap (pitfall #64)
better-sqlite3 nvm vs system node mismatch — always rebuild with the SAME binary the backend runs under (pitfall #52)
Flutter Web URL-as-initial-route can shadow Consumer-based home — always set initialRoute: '/' (pitfall #53)
Flutter Web <video> element cannot send Authorization headers — pass JWT via query param ?token= (pitfall #62)
SSE streaming over Cloudflare HTTP/2 tunnel gets buffered — need heartbeat ('ping') + fast first-chunk timeout + non-streaming fallback
Flutter Web event loop: network requests can block notifyListeners frame render — add small delay before network request
OverlayEntry is more reliable than Stack for Flutter Web overlays — Stack-based drawer had rendering issues on Web
IndexedStack preserves tab state in bottom navigation — better than rebuilding screen on tab switch
AppLogger with kDebugMode guard is silenced in release builds — use debugPrint for production-visible logging in SSE/networking code
Flutter Web SSE fallback URL double-prefix bug: dio baseUrl '/api' + full url '/api/ai/chat' = '/api/api/ai/chat' — always strip the baseUrl prefix from the URL before passing to dio.post
addPostFrameCallback guarantees frame paint completion on Flutter Web Safari — Future.delayed(50ms) does NOT guarantee paint, causing blank chat on send
ErrorWidget.builder in release mode makes rendering errors visible — default ErrorWidget renders as 0x0 invisible box, masking all layout exceptions
